title: Initial configuration as an embedding
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\mathrm{dec}:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. The initial configuration of the amplified machine on $x$ equals the embedding of that same configuration into run $0$ with counter $0$, using the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
